name: AirTrunk SYD1 Sydney West (phase 1)

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '35 Huntingwood Drive, Huntingwood NSW 2148' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100); point is the address point for the whole SYD1 campus lot.

builder.note: head contractor for phase 1 (D&C). Source page now removed from richardcrookes.com.au; details seen in search snippet only. Later phases by other contractors (e.g. A W Edwards Phase 4, source 7)

developer.note: applicant Airtrunk Pty Ltd; landowner at DA time AWPT4 Huntingwood Pty Limited

mw_it.note: phase 1 only: 'The first phase boasts 20MW of capacity' (iTnews 20 Sep 2017; Richard Crookes: 8 data halls, 20MW). Later phases are separate rows: airtrunk-syd1-phase2 (10MW, due mid-2018), airtrunk-syd1-phase3-4 (grouped, ~60MW derived) and airtrunk-syd1-healey (24 Healey Circuit, fifth building, 40+MW, July 2022). 2017 master plan >80MW over four phases; campus now 130MW+ across five buildings / 42 data halls (sources 5, 6)

mw_grid.note: 132kV diverse HV feed from two onsite substations; no MW figure

cost_aud_m.note: Capital investment value $47,529,862 for the whole 8-stage DA JRPP-16-03318 (not phase 1 alone). Alternative: iTnews says AirTrunk launched the facility 'after spending more than $200 million' (source 3), which likely includes land ($31m purchase from Frasers Australia, Sep 2016, source 8, snippet only) and fit-out. The CIV also covers later phases on this lot (airtrunk-syd1-phase2, airtrunk-syd1-phase3-4); the 24 Healey Circuit building has its own DA (airtrunk-syd1-healey)

authority.value: Sydney West Joint Regional Planning Panel (assessed by Blacktown City Council)

pathway.value: Development application (regional development, JRPP determination), EP&A Act 1979
pathway.note: staged construction in 8 stages (Stage 1A-4B), 8 x 2-storey data halls, GFA 28,530 sqm

determined.note: planning portal panel page: 'Determination Date 20/10/2016', outcome 'Determined'; determination letter file dated 20161021. Council recommended approval; facility was built, so approval inferred

jobs_construction.note: No construction workforce figure found. iTnews/Richard Crookes: phase 1 'took 460,000 hours of work over 44 weeks' (work hours, not a jobs figure)

jobs_construction_other.note: AirTrunk 2017 launch release quoting NSW Western Sydney minister: 'building this centre has created around 300 jobs'

jobs_operational.note: iTnews: 'will employ 180 staff at its completion' (likely full campus build-out)

jobs_operational_other.note: JRPP report 5.3: '10 to 21 employees are anticipated to be on site at any one time' (on-site concurrency, full 8-stage DA)
same release: '180 more people will be employed here permanently' (matches iTnews figure)

construction_start.note: not found; phase 1 built 'in just 44 weeks' to Sep 2017 completion, implying a start around Nov 2016 (inference only)

construction_end.note: Richard Crookes (snippet): phase 1 completion date September 2017; iTnews 20 Sep 2017 reports launch

open_questions: builder source (Richard Crookes page) seen only in search snippet; page removed
cost: DA CIV $47.5m covers all 8 stages vs '>$200m' spend reported at launch
